title: 第17章 魂师公会第18章 愤怒的罗天
slug: 我修天道见谁都能一招秒
content_zh:
“宗主，这位道友，是我带上山的！”
黄长老适时凑了过来，嬉笑道。
这份功劳，可不能归了别人。
然而……
啪！
地明宗宗主一巴掌拍在黄长老的头上。
“叫什么道友？你配么？你心里没点逼数么？叫大人！”
他怒吼道。
“额……是，大人！”
黄长老立刻对罗天行礼道。
此刻罗天，也是一阵无语。
“不用这么客气，黄长老，咱们的约定还算数吧？”
罗天问道。
“算！
当然算！”
黄长老忙不迭点头道。
“约定？什么约定？”
地明宗宗主一脸不解。
黄长老立刻将罗天的来意，快速说了一遍。
“怎么，宗主大人，这千年钟乳，可以给我么？”

罗天看着他笑着问道。
地明宗宗主浑身一颤，躬身道：“哪里敢让您称我为大人？在下地明宗宗主，贱名魏旭，千年钟乳立刻奉上，只是不知大人名讳……”
噗通！
没等罗天回答，魂师苏老，就跪在了罗天面前。
“大人，小老儿苏平，夜风国魂师公会长老，不知大人您是哪位？天阳皇国的魂师，或者说……您是魂师公会总部来的大人？”
他在罗天面前，毕恭毕敬。
即便唇角还挂着鲜血，却也不敢失了礼数。
而其他人听了这些话，顿时震惊起来。
“天阳皇国？风临洲三大皇国之一的天阳皇国么？”
“也是，大概也只有这种地方，才会有这么强大的魂师吧。”
众人全都暗暗点头。
而人群中的罗天，却是一头雾水。
“什么乱七八糟的？我叫罗天，来自边北城。”
罗天淡然道。
他也懒得隐藏自己的身份。
“边北城？”
众人一时间面面相觑。
他们思索了很久，也想不起边北城是哪家大势力。
唯有一个老者，小心翼翼问道：“莫不是……咱们夜风国北边的那个边北城？”
罗天点头道：“没错，正是。”
content_en:
"Sect Master, I brought this fellow Taoist up the mountain!"
Elder Huang came over at the right time and said with a smile.
This credit cannot go to others.
However...
Snap!
The head of Diming Sect slapped Elder Huang on the head.
"What do you call fellow Taoist? Are you worthy? Don't you have any idea? Call me Sir!"
he roared.
"Uh...yes, sir!"
Elder Huang immediately saluted Luo Tian.
At this moment Luo Tian was also speechless for a while.
"Don't be so polite, Elder Huang, our agreement still stands, right?"
Luo Tian asked.
"Forget it!
Of course it counts! "
Elder Huang nodded hurriedly.
"Agreement? What agreement?"
The head of the Diming Sect looked puzzled.
Elder Huang immediately explained Luo Tian's purpose of coming.
"Why, Lord Sect Master, can you give me this thousand-year-old stalactite?"
Luo Tian looked at him and asked with a smile.
The leader of the Diming Sect trembled all over and bowed: "How dare you call me your lord? I am the leader of the Diming Sect, whose nickname is Wei Xu. I will offer you a thousand-year stalactite immediately, but I don't know my name..."
Plop!
Before Luo Tian could answer, Soul Master Su Lao knelt down in front of Luo Tian.
"Sir, little old man Su Ping, the elder of the Soul Masters Guild of the Night Wind Kingdom, I wonder who you are, sir? A soul master from the Tianyang Empire, or... are you from the headquarters of the Soul Masters Guild?"
He was respectful in front of Luo Tian.
Even though there was still blood hanging from the corners of his lips, he did not dare to lose his etiquette.
Others were shocked when they heard these words.
"Tianyang Empire? Tianyang Empire, one of the three great empires in Feng Linzhou?"
"That's right. It's probably only in a place like this that there can be such a powerful soul master."
Everyone nodded secretly.
But Luo Tian among the crowd was confused.
"What's this mess? My name is Luo Tian, and I'm from Bianbei City."
Luo Tian said calmly.
He didn't bother to hide his identity.
"Bian Beicheng?"
Everyone looked at each other for a moment.
They thought about it for a long time, but they couldn't remember which big force in Bianbeicheng was.
Only an old man asked cautiously: "Could it be... the Bianbei City in the north of our Night Breeze Kingdom?"
Luo Tian nodded and said, "Yes, exactly."
